candidate.title: MALBAC
candidate.scope: The central MALBAC (multiple annealing and looping-based amplification cycles) row of the assigned Illumina schematic, interpreted with the Zong et al. single-cell genomic DNA amplification architecture (PMID 23258894). Scope runs from genomic template and random primers through partial amplicons, recurrent quasi-linear copying, full-amplicon looping and PCR to amplified genomic DNA. SCMDA above and Nuc-Seq/SNES below are separate neighboring rows, not depicted alternatives of MALBAC. No sequencing-adapter construction, sequencing operation or RNA branch is drawn in the target row.
